name: Telegram
summary: Use Secret Chats for E2EE, lock down discoverability, and enable two-step verification.

settings.name: Use Secret Chats
settings.impact: Regular Telegram chats are stored on Telegram's servers and are NOT end-to-end encrypted by default. Secret Chats use device-to-device E2EE — not even Telegram can read them.
settings.source: ESET: 'Telegram Privacy Explained: What's Protected & What's Not'; Kaspersky Messaging Privacy Rankings 2025

settings.name: Two-Step Verification
settings.impact: Telegram accounts are accessed via SMS code only by default. A SIM-swap attack gives an attacker full account access. A second password blocks this.

settings.name: Phone Number Visibility
clickPath: Who can see my number: Nobody
settings.impact: Telegram user discovery relies on phone numbers. Making your number invisible prevents strangers from finding your profile via number lookup.
settings.source: such.chat Security Checklist; ESET Privacy Guide

settings.name: Who Can Add You to Groups
settings.impact: Anyone can add you to groups by default. Scammers exploit this to pull users into fraudulent crypto or phishing group chats. Restricting to contacts blocks this vector.
settings.source: such.chat Security Checklist; Telegram Security Guide 2025

settings.name: Passcode Lock
settings.impact: Without a passcode, anyone who picks up your unlocked phone can read all Telegram messages, including cloud chat history. This adds a layer independent of your phone's screen lock.
